clue.text: George Best, one saved by gold fortune

indicators.note: something saved is held safe inside its rescuer, so these words sit within the outer pair

blocks.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold
the best is the top
Roman numeral one
one's lot is one's fortune or destiny

explanation.surface: A tribute to footballer George Best, a man rescued by his golden fortune.
explanation.walkthrough: George Best the footballer is a red herring: 'George' alone is the definition, and 'Best' gives the first inner piece. AU and LOT surround TOP and I.
explanation.definitionFit: George is old pilots' slang for an aircraft's automatic steering system, so the name stands for the device.

clue.text: Timeless headdress associated with the city

blocks.note: a wound cloth headdress
T is the abbreviation for time, here taken away

explanation.surface: Some timeless piece of headwear is linked with city fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: Urban is the adjective for things belonging to towns and cities.

clue.text: Choice elixir served initially with a twist

blocks.note: an elixir is a magic or medicinal potion

explanation.surface: A bartender serves a choice elixir garnished with a twist of peel.
explanation.walkthrough: Only the first two letters of the elixir trade places; the rest stays as it was.
explanation.definitionFit: An option is a choice, the thing one may pick from alternatives.

clue.text: Meaning setter's left on board

port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: Someone notes the meaning of a setter leaving something lying on a board.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On board' means aboard ship, where left is port.
explanation.definitionFit: The import of a statement is its significance or sense.

clue.text: Worked topless smeared in grease

blocks.note: toiled means worked hard

clue.text: Rock musician not so pious

definitions.note: the answer means making a show of piety, which the surface's 'not so pious' hints at

indicators.note: to rock is to shake, so the following letters are tossed about

blocks.note: the letters taken as written

explanation.surface: A rock musician is said to be not especially devout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rock musician' reads as one phrase, but 'Rock' is the signal and 'musician not so' the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Sanctimonious describes a self-righteous, outwardly pious manner, a sneering sense of devout.

clue.text: Leave student in bed with urges for breakfast?

taken as written

clue.text: Cheap meatball stews in the archbishop's place

blocks.note: the letters taken as written

clue.text: University friend, graduate in advanced position by degrees

blocks.note: grad is short for graduate

an ally is a friend

explanation.surface: A university friend is a graduate already in a senior post.
explanation.walkthrough: University and friend come first in the clue, but the graduate is moved to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Gradually means step by step, little by little, which is what by degrees expresses.

clue.text: Well I never get attracted to husband wearing shabby clothes

clue.text: The number one evil spirit denied freedom from punishment

blocks.note: impunity is exemption from punishment
an imp is a small devil

clue.text: Female taken on by army detachment out of shape

blocks.note: a unit is a detachment of soldiers

clue.text: India had upset head of oriental state

taken as written
first letter of the word

explanation.definitionFit: Idaho is one of the fifty states of the USA.

clue.text: Chay at sea on top of this craft?

the top of a down word is its first letter

blocks.note: the name taken as written
first letter of the word

explanation.surface: Chay Blyth sailing aboard his boat.

explanation.definitionFit: A yacht is a sailing craft, exactly the vessel a long-distance sailor like Chay Blyth would be on.

clue.text: Highly motivated daughter torn

blocks.note: D is the abbreviation for daughter
riven means split or torn apart

explanation.definitionFit: A driven person is strongly motivated, impelled by ambition.

clue.text: Language that might be written by gum!

blocks.note: first meaning: the language of the Arab world

blocks.clueFragment: that might be written by gum
blocks.note: second meaning: the word that may follow gum, naming a plant resin

clue.text: Father caught smuggling a new currency

taken as written

c is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for caught

clue.text: South American resident beset by mega gout inflammation

clue.text: Frank polishes front of Tesla

first letter of the word

clue.text: Solicitor eating starter of raw fish

first letter of the word

first letters of the three words

blocks.note: US for the United States
taken as written

blocks.note: laid as in settled down or put to rest
last letter of the word

clue.text: Cult fanatics flaunting rice crackers

clue.text: More placid, gentle sounding order of nuns
